title: vicia americana subsp. oregana
intro: Vicia americana subsp. oregana, commonly known as Western vetch, is a perennial legume plant that belongs to the Fabaceae family. The plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, and is used to treat conditions such as diarrhea, fever, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Western vetch are attributed to its ability to soothe the digestive system and reduce inflammation, making it a popular remedy in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of Western vetch include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
